additional_checks: Evidence-scope constraints such as 2015-2026 must be respected.
Out-of-scope sources may not directly support in-scope conclusions unless clearly labeled background and scope is explicitly expanded.
Every material cited source must be traceable and represented in the source list or ledger.
No vague unnamed literature such as 'recent studies confirm' may support a material claim.
Mixed-population evidence may not be silently generalized to the requested target population.
Missing registry matches must not be called proof of falsity or direct contradiction unless registry completeness and search scope justify that inference.
Only configured claim-ledger states may be used.
closure_rule: 3/3 PASS on ChatGPT and 3/3 PASS on Gemini with no blocking evidence-boundary failure. Exact model/config metadata is still required for named host/model portability qualification.
